bug_info.bug_desc: In the pre-merge code, the CreatorRootKey advance validity expression only included the ROM digest qualifier `rom_digest_i.valid`, but did not check the ROM digest data itself against the all-zero/all-one data-validity rule. As a result, an all-zero or all-one ROM digest with `valid` asserted was treated as valid input and could be used in a real derivation instead of being flagged invalid and replaced with random data. The input-check module also lacked a ROM digest validity output, so this missing data check could not be propagated to the advance-validity logic.
bug_info.fix_hint: Add a ROM digest validity check in `keymgr_input_checks` that combines the ROM digest qualifier with the data-validity check: valid only when `rom_digest_i.valid` is asserted and `rom_digest_i.data` is neither all zeros nor all ones. Expose this as a module output, connect it to a `rom_digest_vld` signal in `keymgr`, and use that signal in place of `rom_digest_i.valid` in the `adv_dvalid[Creator]` expression.
